_about: Storyboard of the evaluator-facing end-to-end demo in images/generated/demo/.
Three capabilities from three LIVE runs: the whole-scene D435 run of 2026-09-12 (18 objects,
physical frames + Isaac frames), the cut-and-place run of 2026-09-12 (isaac_cut_demo) and the
dismantling run of 2026-09-13 (isaac_fixed_pipe_dismantling); dashboard panels of the cut-aware
decision are captured for the same scenarios. The assembler records nothing and refuses a
missing still. `seconds` is the duration in the long asset, `short_seconds` in the README cut
(0 = not shown there). `subs` change the subtitle at a source-frame offset of a sequence;
`below_banner` fits a still under the title band (dashboard panels); `compare` shows two
stills side by side with captions; a card's `rows` render a two-column summary.
